thread.title: Ron Tusler highlights assembly action on legislation and amendment limiting governor's authority
thread.title_full: Ron Tusler highlights assembly action on legislation and amendment limiting governor's authority

author: B. I. Early
title: Ron Tusler highlights assembly action on legislation and amendment limiting governor's authority
text:
Rep. Ron Tusler, a Republican who has represented Wisconsin’s 3rd House district since 2017, recently used his social media platform to share legislative updates and commentary.
On February 13, 2026, Tusler posted a message about legislative progress: “Please see my press release on the Assembly’s passage of my ‘Red Tape Reset’ bill. https://t.co/3tClyTSXKs”.
The following day, on February 14, 2026, he highlighted another development: “Assembly Passes Constitutional Amendment to Check Governor’s Overreach – https://t.co/svndmPVzZP”.
Tusler also shared a quote from President Theodore Roosevelt on February 16, 2026: ‘”The only man who never makes a mistake is the man who never does anything.” – President Theodore Roosevelt https://t.co/0uCm57szrL’.
Tusler was elected to the Wisconsin State House in 2017 after replacing Alvin Ott as representative for the state’s 3rd House district. Since then, he has been active in promoting legislative measures and providing updates on state government actions through public statements and social media platforms.
